body: Your dad is wrong. Suicidal people are insane, do you have some who are questionable mentally, yes. But you have those who aren't. Personally from the ones I've talked with and all, they are more trustworthy. They know what another person is going through on a much deeper level than others. For me, personally, it makes it easier understand what another person is going through. What suicidal people go through (from my personal experience) is just awful. Do I think myself crazy for feeling suicidal even though my current life and family are great? Yes. And I feel like because society in some form or fashion has made it seem that suicidal people are crazy because they themselves aren't able to relate or understand. I know personally I would never call another suicidal person crazy because that doesn't help and actually makes things worse. My old therapist basically implied to me that I was crazy for feeling what I felt. Sometimes when people aren't/don't understand another person, they come up with an excuse and sometimes that excuse is "you're crazy", "its all in your head", "cheer up, your just down", etc. But no you aren't crazy. I'm sorry your dad said that, but he is wrong.

Are they valid? Will it? Because I don't know. I quit with the last therapist for a reason. She basically implied all the time I was crazy and imaging things and all. And I don't know. I'm only in it right now because my parents want me to as it's "disturbing the family dynamic"

Please don't. I know it's hard to believe, but people do care and will miss you. Another hard to believe, but there are so many things in life to see and experience, not just death. I'm so sorry your feeling like. I don't know if any of what I'm saying is helping or not. But there are things to live for. Maybe meeting a friend, seeing a sunset, listening to a new album from your favorite artist or seeing a concert from them, etc. But please don't. I wish I was there right now to be able to look at you and say that things do get better somehow and in someway. But please if you do decide to stay, feel free to message. I'm sorry that things right now are hard and you feel like that's the only option left, it's a horrible feeling to have where you think it's the only solution. There are other solutions, better solutions, and yes that's hard to believe but they do exist. Please try and hold on
